title: Decision: Store errors map to 500, not 401
description: Why this is good: When ContactStore returns an error (e.g., DB lock contention, disk corruption), authorize() maps it to AuthError::WhoIsFailed, which causes the HTTP layer to return 500 (Internal Server Error), not 401 (Unauthorized). This implements 'fail closed' — a transient error is treated as a system failure, not as evidence that the caller should be denied. Conversely, an actual authorization denial (contact not found, or blocked) returns Unauthorized (401). This distinction is critical: silent 401 on a DB error would silently deny service, while 500 signals operators that the system is broken. The tests explicitly verify this behavior (test_store_error_is_not_unauthorized) by forcing a DB error.
